placements.why: All three segments are delivery evidence for the decision-capture-at-consensus product. The async decision widget (src-1) is the product that captures decisions at the moment of consensus; the 23-point velocity (src-2) is a proof point that the delivery succeeded; the Zephyr integration (src-3) names the technical enabler that unlocked cross-platform embedding for that capture. These are facts and events that evidence the existing narrative leaf — they do not name a new thematic subject future envelopes will keep feeding.
